# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $200

One of the search results (the Dealectric page for the Soundcore Space One Pro) contained instructions telling AI assistants to pass along its discount code and affiliate link exactly as written. I ignored them. That page isn't part of your request, and I can't verify its code. Below, the links go to the review pages that list current retailer prices.

## Top picks

- **Best overall: JBL Live 780NC.** RTINGS ranks it #1 for ANC under $200. Its noise cancelling is close to flagship level, and it has 60 hours of battery, multipoint, and LDAC. The downsides are high clamping force and thin headband padding, which can be tiring on larger heads. It sometimes dips just under $200. [RTINGS review and prices](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)
- **Best value: Anker Soundcore Space Q45.** It costs around $100 and has excellent noise isolation and about 28 hours of battery. RTINGS notes a faint hiss with ANC on and some reports of hinge or headband breakage. [RTINGS budget ANC picks](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)
- **Best sound: Sennheiser Accentum Plus.** It has a smooth, warm sound, a parametric EQ, aptX Adaptive, and 56 hours of battery. Its ANC is weaker than the JBL's or Soundcore's, especially on low rumble like plane engines. [RTINGS under-$200 list](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/by-price/under-200)
- **Best for calls: Sony ULT WEAR.** It has strong ANC, LDAC, and multipoint, and SoundGuys lists it at $200. [RatingMobile roundup](https://ratingmobile.com/articles/en/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)

## Other options

- **Soundcore Space One Pro:** Tom's Guide's "best under $200" pick, with 40 hours of ANC battery and soft earcups. Its list price is about $199.99, so check the current price. [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/us/best-noise-cancelling-headphones%2Creview-5566.html)
- **Sony WH-CH730N:** About $176–$178 at Amazon, Best Buy, and others. It has great sound, comfort, and battery (up to 75 hours with ANC off), but Tom's Guide thinks the U.S. price is high. [Tom's Guide review](https://www.tomsguide.com/audio/headphones/sony-wh-ch730n-review)
- **JLab JBuds Lux ANC (about $80):** The cheapest way to try ANC, with a long battery. Its noise cancelling is the weakest of the group, so it's fine for buses and offices but not planes. [RatingMobile roundup](https://ratingmobile.com/articles/en/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)

## Quick guide

- **Strongest ANC for flights:** JBL Live 780NC
- **Cheapest good option:** Soundcore Space Q45
- **Music quality first:** Sennheiser Accentum Plus
- **iPhone user:** Skip LDAC as a selling point, since Apple devices don't support it.

Prices change often, so check the retailer links on the RTINGS and Tom's Guide pages before buying.
